thesis: Moat attacks combat at the rules level, dividing creatures into those that can cross the battlefield and those that effectively cease to matter.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Moat anchored classic white-blue control and later enchantment strategies, becoming a lasting shorthand for prison effects that invalidate an entire class of attackers.

playbook.role: Build with flyers, planeswalkers, direct damage, or noncombat win conditions so the restriction is one-sided. Cast Moat before the opponent’s ground force converts its development into lethal damage.
